items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 124:1
items.html:
(to the question) The world of the male
Bina is called the world of the male, relative to her NHY that clothe in ZA, which is male. (Part 1, Page 131, Item 13).
